text.p: The average yields at auctions of three-, six-, nine-, and 12-month yields slipped from the last sale on February 18, a central bank statement said on Friday.

Three-month bills fell to 27.88 percent from 28.99 percent, six-month bills fell to 33.90 percent from 35.67 percent, nine-month bills edged down to 36.99 percent from 39.08 percent, and 12-month bills eased to 38.65 percent from 40.86 percent.
The results of Thursday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 17.00 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Amount sold 17.00 million UAH 7.86 million UAH
Actual amount raised 15.89 million UAH 7.33 million UAH
The central bank sold 170,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 140,441 were competitive and 29,559 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is February 25.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit 17.00 million UAH
Amount sold 31.10 million UAH 16.24 million UAH
Actual amount raised 26.61 million UAH 13.79 million UAH
The central bank sold 311,053 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 104,202 were competitive and 206,851 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is February 21.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit 25.00 million UAH
Amount sold 35.62 million UAH 25.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 27.90 million UAH 19.34 million UAH
The central bank sold 356,225 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 255,331 were competitive and 100,894 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is February 21.
The results of 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit 35.00 million UAH
Amount sold 22.03 million UAH 35.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 15.89 million UAH 24.87 million UAH
The central bank sold 220,281 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 207,814 were competitive and 12,467 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is February 21.
